sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Birdeye is a Rogue Boss in Escape from Tarkov. He is part of the "Goon squad".

sections.heading: Biography
sections.text: Birdeye stayed loyal to his commander even after Knight stopped following USEC HQ’s orders. He controls a wide area and spots enemies first, often eliminating them before Big Pipe and Knight even engage the target.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Birdeyes's footsteps have reduced volume.
- Killing Birdeye as a Scav does not carry any penalties towards your Scav karma.
- Birdeye has different health values than PMCs and Scavs.

- Instead of the typical 4 single slot pockets, he has 5 double slot pockets, bringing their total space to 10 slots.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Birdeye needs to be killed for the quest Stray Dogs.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: Birdeye and the other members of the the Goon squad, Knight and Big Pipe can not be found in all of the below locations at the same time, but wander through them. Meaning if they are at one location, they will be absent from the others. Their location changes every 3.5 to 5 hours.

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text: In the construction area around the laboratory and the Scav base, as well as on the third floor of the northern building of the industrial plant.

sections.heading: Woods
sections.text: At the antenna in the northwest (Scav Bunker extraction).

sections.heading: Shoreline
sections.text: At the weather station on the hill in the southeast.

sections.heading: Lighthouse
sections.text: At the water treatment plant in the north, and at the blue chalet.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text: Birdeye seems to sit back and let Knight and Big Pipe push the opposing enemy first. If they do not succeed and die, he seems to rush the player. His steps have reduced noise.

sections.heading: Customs Scav base
sections.text:
The best way to deal with the Goons on Customs is to gain their attention while you are at the "Crackhouse" (medical building east of the Scav base). This can easily done by just walking around near the second story windows.

After gaining the attention of the Goons your best choice to kill them would be to sit in a room such as the dining room on the first floor and close the door, as this will create a small time period of them opening the door allowing you to shoot them with no repercussions.

Keep in mind that Birdeye will stay behind and wait till the action is over to show himself. In order to get Birdeye to show himself you either can wait for him to push you after you kill Knight and Big Pipe, or you could throw grenades in his direction in order to pinpoint his location.

sections.heading: Woods Antenna
sections.text: Due to the Goons extremely long spotting distance it is a hard task to fight them at this location. This means that trying to fight them at this location is a very high risk decision.

sections.heading: Shoreline Weather station
sections.text:
You first want to get the attention of the Goons. This can be easily done by playing a game of "Chicken" with them by quickly running up and down the hill until you hear voice lines or you start getting shot at.

Once you gain their attention you want to run down the hill a little bit and wait for them to push you. Make sure to not hold an angle where only your head is exposed, such as leaning behind a tree.

Both Knight and Big Pipe will rush towards you, giving you a chance to shoot them. After Big Pipe and Knight are dealt with, Birdeye will reposition to find an angle on you, or he will rush you.

Birdeye is an extremely easy kill if he's out in the open and in close range. If he decides to reposition your best options are to throw grenades to find him or try to get him to rush you by continuously re-peeking him until he pushes you.

sections.heading: Lighthouse Blue chalet
sections.text: Try to push into the chalet and wait in the first floor sauna room for them to push you. Use the rocks on the east side in order to safely enter the building.

sections.heading: Lighthouse Water treatment plant
sections.text: They can spawn in many locations in the area, but most of the time luring them into buildings will keep you safe from cross fire.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- Birdeye's named weapon variants "Kiowa" and "Mescalero" are most likely referring to Native American Apache tribes of the same name.
  - The word "bacho" as seen in his weapon variant "Ba-cho", refers to a wolf in Apache languages.
  - Since he also uses face paint, just like Apache tribes did, it is possible he is from Native American descent.
- Birdeye's named weapon variant "Your-Ex" is possibly a play on "URX" weapon parts from Knight's Armament Company, while the only used KAC parts are the iron sights.
- Birdeye wears a Drifire Fortrex FR combat pants (identifiable by the square frontal pockets & stitching around the knees) in M81 Woodland camouflage, and a fanny pack in Desert Night pattern around his waist. Both items are frequently seen used by MARSOC operators.
- His piece of upper wear appears to be a Baja jacket, possibly inspired by this picture of a MARSOC operator wearing one, as the pattern on Birdeye's jacket and also the model of combat pants match the picture.
- Birdeye and Big Pipe have a friendly rivalry, evidenced by voice lines such as:"Fellas, you good! Not you, Pipe." (Birdeye)
